flowRoot.flowPara: When you play a skill with Shadowstrike, each of your Shadows copy the strike, dealing half damage.

TIP: Mastering the use of Shadows is key to playing the Traceless well. You can always create Shadows easily with Displacer Strike, but other skills can do it too. Set up one or two Shadows before using Gloom Edge for big damage.
TIP: Leave the booklet open to this page as you will use these skills frequently!
TIP: This is your Innate skill. That means its always active. In tandem with the Shadowstrike keyword detailed below, it's a vital part of the Traceless' skill-set.
TIP: This is your Basic skill. It's a lot weaker than most of your other skills, but it never needs to recharge.
Whenever you shift out of a square, you may place a Shadow mark on that square. Shadows fade at end of turn.
As a free action, you my consume a Shadow to teleport to its square.
Shift 2 squares. Before or after the shift, strike target foe for 4 damage.
Shadowstrike (Each of your Shadows copy this strike, dealing half the damage).
For each Shadow mark on the battlefield, your Armor is increased by 1.
